author: Channel4News
text:
"My prediction is that kids growing up won't be smarter than AI."

Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI, which owns ChatGPT, said that the world was yet to fully grasp how quickly AI could speed up development.

Speaking at North Carolina's G20 innovation Ministerial conference with US Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, Mr Altman also urged governments to adopt the technology, saying doing otherwise would be comparable to rejecting electricity during the industrial era.

author: SwyisseAi
text:
The important question may not be whether children can become smarter than AI.

It’s what we teach children when access to intelligence becomes almost unlimited.

Curiosity, judgement, critical thinking and knowing which questions to ask could become more valuable than simply memorising information.

Education may have to change because intelligence itself is changing.
